summaries: A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD joint statistical release (Report CB22-156) detailing new residential construction statistics for August 2022. Relevant to the task: The document provides seasonally adjusted annual rate (SAAR) figures for Housing Starts (categorized by single-family "1 unit" and buildings with "5 units or more") and Seasonally Adjusted Total Units Under Construction for August 2022, alongside revised July 2022 data in Tables 3a and 4a. It contributes data for the initial month (August 2022) of the requested 2022/08–2025/05 timeframe, enabling month-over-month trend analysis. For August 2022 specifically, the data indicates single-family starts increased, starts for buildings with five or more units increased, and total units under construction increased; consequently, this month does not meet the task's criteria for a decrease in 5+ unit starts.

A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD press release reporting new residential construction statistics for September 2022, released October 19, 2022. It contributes seasonally adjusted data for September 2022 and revised August 2022, covering the beginning portion of the task's specified timeframe. Table 3a details housing starts (single-family and 5+ units), showing single-family starts decreased from 936,000 to 892,000 and 5+ unit starts decreased from 610,000 to 530,000. Table 4a details units under construction, showing an increase from 1,702,000 to 1,710,000. This document supplies the specific metrics required to evaluate the task's three conditions for September 2022, serving as the authoritative source for that month's values, though it does not extend to the full timeframe ending in May 2025.

A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD joint press release reporting new residential construction statistics for October 2022 (released November 17, 2022). Specifically, Table 3a indicates single-family starts decreased month-over-month (-4.1%) while starts for five or more units increased (+4.8%). Table 4a shows total units under construction remained flat (0.0% change) from October to November. Consequently, November 2022 fails to meet the task's required conditions (single-family starts up, 5+ unit starts down, units under construction up). As the specific release for this period, it provides the authoritative baseline for November 2022 within the collection.
